proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2389 uṣṇa explicitly includes Prakrit usiṇa, Kashmiri wuśun hot and western Gujarati ūnũ/Marathi ūn. The Bashkarik ūṣūn matches the attested Jambu úṣu᷄́n hot (gawri, f_i33dpbqp24rpe); Bhil unːu matches the western n-series. This does not resolve possible regional transmission. Exact source form unːu is preserved.
